description: Cloudflare Radar AI bots: which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot, ...) generate how much of AI-bot traffic. Returns percentage shares by user agent, by crawl purpose (training, search, user action) or by industry of the crawled sites, over a date range, globally or for one country. Pass user_agent to get a single crawler's share; an unknown user agent returns found:false.

user_agent.description: Only with dimension=user_agent: look up one crawler by name, e.g. "GPTBot".

name: radar_ai_bots
